title: Injectivity and surjectivity in equal finite dimensions
statement: Let $k$ be a field [def-weil-field], let $V,W$ be finite-dimensional $k$-vector spaces [def-weil-finite-dimensional-subspace], and let $f:V\to W$ be $k$-linear. If $\dim_kV=\dim_kW$ [def-weil-vector-space-dimension], then $f$ is injective if and only if it is surjective.
